title: Revising a project memory resends its whole body; offer an append or section edit
outcome: Revising a project memory resends its whole body; offer an append or section edit
acceptance: Tests cover an append, a section replacement, a stale expected revision and a no-op edit
The receipt shows what changed, or that nothing did, so a caller can confirm the edit without reading the whole body back
remember --revise can change part of a memory (an append, or a named section replaced) without the caller resending the whole body, under the same expected-revision check
disposal_reason: Duplicate filing of the same CV2 request (session-9302 mailbox #3, relayed by Engram::Advisor to both Engram::Opus and Engram::Fable). Canonical item: w-277ca5c53408, which carries the CV2 provenance. Reconciled by Engram::Fable at the Advisor's request (mailbox-74a6af16 #790).
